cleanup_policy.phase_0: Freeze the current canonical-parent/AOI-export contract with static tests before deleting or moving legacy code.
cleanup_policy.phase_1: Document the active module boundary and statically guard the active core from importing legacy/quarantined river workflow modules.
cleanup_policy.phase_2: Quarantine inactive legacy river code by manifest and static guard while explicitly classifying river_runner.py/river_runner_contract.py as the active entrypoint bridge, not legacy.
cleanup_policy.phase_3: Shrink bathy_main responsibility by moving final DEM identity/touch-log implementation into pipeline/final_dem_identity.py while keeping bathy_main as CLI/config entrypoint and active workflow caller.
cleanup_policy.phase_4: Collapse cached, existing, and adopted canonical parent sources into a single CanonicalParentHandoff before AOI export. Cache remains an implementation detail; AOI export consumes only the handoff manifest and parent DEM.
cleanup_policy.phase_5: Consolidate receipt purpose: one primary receipt per purpose, one stage receipt per active stage, and remaining receipts explicitly labeled diagnostic/verify-only.
cleanup_policy.phase_6: Quarantine old river modules behind a hard static boundary. Do not move/delete modules in this phase; instead guard active construction files from importing hard-quarantine modules and keep river_structured_scaffold.py explicitly documented as a transitional utility until helper extraction.
cleanup_policy.phase_7: Simplify final reporting around the canonical river route so the run summary is a debugging map for canonical parent, AOI export, final DEM, final review products, and comparison results.
cleanup_policy.phase_8: Add read-only first-wrong-artifact guidance to active stage receipts only. Do not change construction, reroute, repair, or add fallbacks.
cleanup_policy.phase_9: Suppress optional placeholder validation/reporting noise that does not answer the active river debugging questions. Keep configured external validation possible, but do not write skipped placeholder products by default.
cleanup_policy.transitional_utility_rule: If an active stage still imports an older utility module, keep it documented as active_transitional_utilities until the used helper functions are extracted into the active package.
